name: bitwise_not
description: FlagOS #6619. OpenCV CUDA reference opencv_contrib@b67a855188a3d683813731010f6d39ac614733a4/modules/cudaarithm/src/cuda/bitwise_mat.cu. Compute the bitwise complement of src.
